children: Brazil's 2027 budget bill, submitted to Congress on Monday, projects an effective primary surplus of 18.6 billion reais  ($3.59 billion) for the central government, equivalent to 0.13% of gross domestic product.
If achieved, it would mark the first annual primary surplus for the central government since 2022, when the surplus amounted to 0.55% of GDP.
